title: Brother Victor pushed down an elevator shaft
summary: Peter Levenda tells of Brother Victor pushed down an elevator shaft, about 1968 at Russian Orthodox Church Outside Russia, Park Avenue and 93rd Street, Manhattan, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Russian Orthodox Church Outside Russia, Park Avenue and 93rd Street, Manhattan

tellings.quote: in which case they pushed him down an elevator shaft and broke his legs.
